visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a colorful headband and a denim apron over a white shirt acts dramatically in a kitchen environment, initially holding oven mitts on his head. (2) He slams his hands onto a wooden kitchen counter where three lemons sit on a brown plate, using a split-screen effect for emphasis. (3) He is seen talking on a smartphone, then laughing and covering his mouth with both hands in a joyous reaction. (4) He serves a plate containing a burnt-looking, dark-brown steak and two pieces of broccoli to a woman sitting at a dining table with a decorated Christmas tree in the background. (5) The woman looks disappointed and then angry, standing up to leave while the man gestures desperately with his arm outstretched. (6) The man then holds up a large red and white KFC SEOUL branded bucket, presenting it to the woman. (7) Close-up shots feature various fried chicken pieces topped with white cheese and red/green spices, egg tarts, and a biscuit being drizzled with sauce. (8) The man and woman sit together at the table, surrounded by numerous KFC boxes and buckets, eating the food and laughing, though the man eventually eats alone with a melancholic but satisfied expression.
